topics.label: Lecture opening and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture's objectives and outlines the main themes to be covered.

topics.label: Tumor viruses, proto-oncogenes, and cellular transformation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace the discovery of transforming viruses, the identification of cellular proto-oncogenes, and the laboratory assays used to test cellular transformation.

topics.label: Oncogenes, tumor suppressor genes, and mutation mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the classifications of cancer-associated gene mutations and examine their operational mechanisms using cell cycle regulators like Rb and p53.

topics.label: Mechanisms and consequences of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how defective DNA repair pathways and mitotic errors cause sequence instability and chromosomal instability in cancer cells.

topics.label: Multi-step tumor progression and hereditary cancer predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how sequential somatic mutation accumulation and inherited cancer predispositions drive tumor progression and malignancy.

topics.label: Closing remarks and recommended reading
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with closing remarks, recommended reading, and logistics for upcoming sessions.
